name: DiffusioNeRF
definition: A method that utilizes a denoising diffusion model to learn priors for scene geometry and color, normalizing the geometry and color of the scene to achieve better quality in reconstructed geometry under sparse input views.
summary: DiffusioNeRF integrates a denoising diffusion model to guide NeRF optimization, improving reconstruction quality under sparse input views by leveraging learned scene priors.
